sim.warning: This simulator runs on a computer connected to the internet: the opposite of the isolation the hardware gives. Use it to learn and to try things out; for real funds, build the signer.
sim.unavailable: The simulator could not start in this browser: it needs JavaScript and WebAssembly.
sim.device: The signer: a 128 × 64 screen and five buttons
sim.line_busy: Sending tones by cable: {seconds} s left.
sim.signed: The signed PSBT, as the signer gave it back (base64):
sim.keyboard: Keyboard: the arrows and Enter (OK). Hold a key as you would hold the button.
sim.step.1: Press OK to pass the welcome screen, then OK on “Load seed”.
sim.step.2: Send the test seed: the public BIP-39 test seed (“abandon … about”), never for real funds.
sim.step.3: Type the PIN {pin}: the arrows move, OK adds a character, and holding OK finishes.
sim.step.4: Check the seed fingerprint, 73c5da0a, press OK, then OK again for no passphrase, and OK on the “Wallet fingerprint”.
sim.step.5: Choose “Sign PSBT” and send the test PSBT.
sim.step.6: Read every page of the review with ▼, tap OK, then hold OK to sign. The signed PSBT appears below, and as QR codes on the screen.
